en.topic_title: Hong Kong records second-rainiest July, with double the average rainfall and 20 amber rainstorm warnings issued
en.topic_summary:
This past month was Hong Kong’s second-rainiest July on record, the city’s observatory has said, with a total of 20 amber rainstorm warnings and five red rainstorm warnings issued.



People walking in the rain on July 15, 2026 in Mong Kok. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



According to the Hong Kong Observatory (HKO), rain fell on all but four days in July: July 11, 12, 22, and 24.



The total monthly rainfall in July was 790.3 mm, more than double the average July rainfall, the HKO said i
